title: Page the list of items
goal: Clients with many items fetch them a page at a time and know how many there are.

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /todos takes limit (1 to 100) and offset (0 or more), written in decimal digits only. They apply after the filters, to the items in id order: offset skips items, limit caps how many are returned. Either can be given without the other.

Every 200 answer of GET /todos has an X-Total-Count header: the number of items that pass the filters, whatever limit and offset say. An offset past the end answers 200 with an empty list and that count.
Any other limit or offset answers 400 with an error that names the parameter: 0 or 101 as limit, a negative number, 1.5, 1e2, an empty value, or the parameter given twice.
Without limit and offset the body is what it is today. README.md describes the two parameters and the header.

context.notes: Keep node:http only; no dependencies. Add tests for every acceptance criterion.
